task: Build a transparent geospatial levelized-cost model for African green hydrogen delivered to Europe via ammonia shipping and reconversion by 2030

key_commitments.supply_chain: PV/Wind generation → Electrolysis → H2 storage → Ammonia synthesis → Shipping → Ammonia cracking → Delivered H2
key_commitments.scenarios: Multiple financing and policy scenarios including de-risking and interest rate variations
key_commitments.comparison: African delivered cost vs European production cost
key_commitments.spatial: Identify least-cost locations across African sites

geographic_scope: African production sites (Namibia region) to European demand center (Rotterdam)
